enabled.description: A Boolean value indicating whether the job is enabled.

created.description: The date and time the job was created.

lastModified.description: The date and time the job was last modified.

nextRunTime.description: The date and time the job is scheduled to be run next.

intervalUnit.description: A string representing the interval unit for the job (Hour/Day/Week/Month).

intervalValue.description: An integer that represents how many of the selected interval unit the job should wait before running again.

logVerbosity.description: A number indicating the level of log verbosity (1-5).

JobLastRun.description: The last run metrics for the job, including the date and time, duration, status, rows affected, and next run time.

nextRunTime.description: The date and time the job is scheduled to be run next.

JobParams.description: An object containing job parameters. Caching jobs use the fields below; other job types may include additional properties.

sourceConnection.description: The Id of the source connection.

sourceConnectionName.description: The name of the source connection. Returned in responses.

sourceSchema.description: The schema in the source connection that contains the table being cached.

sourceTable.description: The name of the table in the source connection to cache.

timeCheckColumn.description: The column used to detect changes for incremental caching. Leave empty to refresh the full table.

autoTruncateStrings.description: Whether to truncate string values that exceed the destination column length. Accepted as a string by the API ("true" or "false").

mergeKeys.description: The columns used to match source rows against cached rows during a merge. Mark each column that is part of the primary key with `isPrimaryKey: true`; supplying more than one such entry defines a composite primary key.

isPrimaryKey.description: Whether the column is part of the primary key. Set `true` on multiple columns to define a composite primary key.
